messages:
emma: Heads-up: we're running a "Maintainer Orientation" office hours next Wed 9:00am PT for folks new to repo maintenance. Short agenda: access flow, release checklist, and triage playbook. RSVP + time preferences: https://tiny.redwood/maintainer-orient

raj: Will this be recorded? I have a client meeting then.

emma: Yes, recording + bullet notes will be uploaded to the handbook repo and linked in #announcements.

linh: 9am PT is tough for APAC. Can we run a second session or post a YT recording?

emma: Good call. There's a poll on the RSVP page to pick a repeat slot if needed.

mateo: Can I demo the release script (how we cut a patch release)? I can take ~15m.

emma: Please do — adding a 15 demo slot for the release script. Thanks @mateo.

ashley: I'll bring the updated PR template and a quick checklist for onboarding PRs.

ops-bot: calendar invite created: Maintainer Orientation Office Hours  Wed 09:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood/evt/9342 (organizer: emma)

riley: Draft agenda:
- 09:00 Quick intro (5m)
- 09:05 Access & write-perms flow (10m)
- 09:15 Release checklist + demo (15m)
- 09:30 PR triage patterns (15m)
- 09:45 Q&A & follow-ups (15m)

emma: Thanks all. Please RSVP, drop any questions here, and we'll post the recording + notes to https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers/handbook after the session. :thumbsup:
